SEARCH
Package persist.lint.api.spi

Interface NamedObjectParser

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, PersistenceLinter
All Known Implementing Classes:
JakartaNamedObjectParser, LegacyNamedObjectParser
public interface NamedObjectParser extends PersistenceLinter, AutoCloseable
Service provider interface for parsing and validating named JPA objects (queries and stored procedures) at build time.

Implementations compile a JPQL query string or validate a stored procedure declaration against the project's entity metamodel, verifying syntax, entity references, and property paths without requiring a live database connection.

This interface extends AutoCloseable. Implementations typically hold heavyweight resources such as a Hibernate SessionFactory and ServiceRegistry that must be released after use. Callers should always use try-with-resources to ensure proper cleanup:


 try (NamedObjectParser parser = factory.newNamedObjectParser(entityClassNames)) {
     parser.parseQuery(name, jpql);
 }
Since:
2.0.0

  • Method Details

    • parseQuery

      NamedObjectDescriptor parseQuery(String name, String queryString)
      Parses and semantically validates the given JPQL query string.

      If the query contains syntax errors or references unknown entities or properties, the implementation should throw an appropriate runtime exception.

      Parameters:
      name - the logical name of the query (e.g., the value of @NamedQuery.name)
      queryString - the JPQL query string to validate
      Returns:
      a descriptor containing the query metadata and discovered parameters
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the query is syntactically or semantically invalid

    • parseStoredProcedure

      NamedObjectDescriptor parseStoredProcedure(String name, String procedureName, Set<String> parameterNames)
      Validates a named stored procedure declaration.

      The implementation records the procedure name and its parameter names into a NamedObjectDescriptor for downstream consumption.

      Parameters:
      name - the logical name of the stored procedure (e.g. the value of @NamedStoredProcedureQuery.name)
      procedureName - the database procedure name
      parameterNames - the set of parameter names declared on the stored procedure
      Returns:
      a descriptor containing the stored procedure metadata
